notes: Several Park streets have no heading of their own in 1894-95 and appear only as italic sub-lines inside another street's listing: Derby Terrace (own numbers 2-9), Barrack Lane and Clinton Terrace (Derby road numbers 119-139) inside Derby rd; Newcastle Terrace (one line, no number) inside Derby rd; Hermitage Walk and Huntingdon Drive inside Lenton road. Those lines appear both under Derby Road/Lenton Road and under the sub-street (Clinton Terrace, Newcastle Terrace, Hermitage Walk and Huntingdon Drive are listed twice on purpose; Derby Terrace and Barrack Lane appear only as 'note' placeholders in Derby Road). Derby Road runs out along the odd side from Chapel bar to Lenton/Radford and back along the even side; italic prefixes such as Rock terrace, Lenton sands, Brunel terrace, Park Hill terrace and Cemetery cottages carry their own numbering, noted per entry. Clumber Crescent North, Albury Square, Hardwick Road and Tunnel Road have no listing. Sir Samuel G. Johnson appears at both Flixton (Cavendish Cres N) and Holm lea (Pelham Crescent); Ar. Lewis of Elmsdale appears under both Clare Valley and Tattershall Drive. Page numbers are scan numbers (printed page = scan - 17).
